Meet the world's smallest species of flamingo! 🦩✨

The lesser flamingo weighs between 1.2 to 2.7 kg and stands 80 to 90 cm tall. These birds are known for their pinkish white plumage and extensive black on the bill.

Have you ever seen a flamingo this small in the wild?
